commons.title: Sibú.Costa.Rica.Museo.Oro.jpg
commons.description: Gold pendant shaped in human form with bird mask, articled in three pieces, resembling Sibö, major Bribri deitie. Such articulated metal pieces are only found in Costa Rica, and are uniqued within the metallurgy of Americas. South Pacific Costa Rica, 700-1550 AC. 14,7 x 12 cm. Museo del Oro Precolombino, San Jose, Costa Rica.
commons.editorial_reason: The caption explicitly identifies the gold pendant as resembling Sibö, a major Bribri deity, and the object visibly represents Bribri-associated material culture.
